column1: # Cases that exist to reach code cases.tsv never executes.
# cases.tsv was assembled to be fast and to cover the common reaction paths, and
# it is not a coverage suite.  Measuring it with `-fprofile-instr-generate`
# showed whole families of functions at 0.00%: every compartment routine, the
# cluster overlap sweep, the unimolecular observable counter, the span-check
# reflectors.  Refactoring any of those while trusting cases.tsv would have
# produced an unverified change that reported "identical" in the same words as a
# verified one.
# Run this table the same way as cases.tsv:
#   CASES_FILE=coverage_cases.tsv ./run_suite.sh <binary> <label> 1
#   ./compare_suites.sh <baseline-label> <candidate-label> ...
# Columns: id <TAB> input directory (under sample_inputs/) <TAB> parm file
#          <TAB> nItr <TAB> optional parameter line to inject
# The fifth column switches on a feature the stock model leaves off.  Mind what
# it does *not* prove: `clusterOverlapCheck` is echoed into every restart file,
# so a case whose output changes only in restart*.dat has recorded the flag and
# nothing else.  Of four models tried with it, only
# mem_localization/SmallBox/FastDsol changes a DATA trajectory; the other three
# (implicit_lipid, sphere, clathrin) differ in restart files alone and do not
# reach the cluster code at all.  Only the one that does is kept.
# What each case is here for, measured by merging its profile and reading
# `llvm-cov report -show-functions`.  Everything still at 0.00% after this table
# runs is listed in known_uncovered.tsv.
# Compartment transmission: check_compartment_reaction (52%),
# determine_exiting_compartment_probability (100%),
# determine_compartment_probability (67%), prob_exiting_compartment.
# nItr is 4000 on purpose: this sample segfaults somewhere between 8000 and
# 12000 iterations, on the pre-refactor binary too.  See known_broken.tsv.
compartment
# Unimolecular state change: count_unimolecular_observable, and the
# check_for_unimolstatechange_reactions path around it.
unimol_state_change
# Volume exclusion between bound partners: the `if (canExclude == true)` half of
# check_bimolecular_reactions(), which no case in cases.tsv enters at all - line
# 202 there had 0 hits until this case existed.  It is the only sample with both
# excludeVolumeBound set on a reaction and enough molecules to form pairs (the
# Gag model sets it too but holds a single molecule).  Reaches the 3D arms of
# that half, and with them two of the five record_crossing_pair() sites; the 2D
# and 1D arms need membrane-bound or fiber-bound partners and stay dark.
gagsphere
# Cluster overlap sweep, box variant: collect_cluster_partners,
# resample_partner_trajectories, sweep_separation_complex_rot_memtest_cluster_box.
# The only box model found where turning the flag on changes a DATA trajectory.
cluster_mem_loc
# Cluster overlap sweep, sphere variant: gag on a spherical membrane, which is
# the only model found with complexes bound to a *sphere* that crowd enough to
# need overlap resolution.  Reaches sweep_separation_complex_rot_memtest_cluster_sphere
# at 86%, and both cluster helpers at 100%.  This case is the expensive one at
# roughly a minute; 1000 iterations is the smallest count that still gets there
# (the fallback sweep_separation_complex_rot_memtest_sphere needs ~20000, which
# costs eleven minutes, so that one stays in known_uncovered.tsv).
cluster_gagsphere
